request: if 6 people all shake hands with each other, how many handshakes is that?

beats.intent: Six people as dots in a circle, labelled A to F
beats.narration: Six people stand in a circle.
beats.code:
stage.title("Handshakes")
names = "ABCDEF"
nodes = {n: (0.8 * np.cos(PI / 2 - k * TAU / 6), 0.9 * np.sin(PI / 2 - k * TAU / 6)) for k, n in enumerate(names)}
dots, _ = draw_network(stage, nodes, [])

beats.intent: A's five handshakes drawn as lines to everyone else
beats.narration: A shakes hands with the other five.
beats.code:
pos = {n: d.get_center() for n, d in dots.items()}
a_lines = [Line(pos["A"], pos[n], color=YELLOW) for n in "BCDEF"]
stage.play(*[Create(l) for l in a_lines])
stage.add(*a_lines)
stage.caption("A: 5 handshakes")

beats.intent: All 15 lines between the six people drawn
beats.narration: B has four left to do, C three, D two and E one. Every pair is joined once.
beats.code:
rest = [Line(pos[a], pos[b], color=BLUE) for i, a in enumerate(names) for b in names[i + 1:] if a != "A"]
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(l) for l in rest], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(*rest)
stage.caption("5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15")

beats.narration: Or: each of six people shakes five hands, and every handshake is counted twice. Six times five over two is fifteen.

request: how do I find the point halfway between two points?

beats.intent: A grid with the points (1, 1) and (5, 3) joined by a line
beats.narration: Here are two points, one, one and five, three.
beats.code:
stage.title("The midpoint")
p = draw_plane(stage, x_extent=6, y_extent=4)
A = mark_point(stage, p, (1, 1), color=BLUE, label="(1, 1)")
B = mark_point(stage, p, (5, 3), color=BLUE, label="(5, 3)")
seg = draw_line(stage, p.c2p(1, 1), p.c2p(5, 3), color=GREY_B)

beats.intent: Half the run and half the rise marked: 2 across and 1 up
beats.narration: Going from one to the other is four across and two up. Halfway is two across and one up.
beats.code:
run = draw_line(stage, p.c2p(1, 1), p.c2p(3, 1), color=GREEN)
rise = draw_line(stage, p.c2p(3, 1), p.c2p(3, 2), color=YELLOW)
stage.label(run, "2", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)
stage.label(rise, "1", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: That lands on three, two: the average of the x's and the average of the y's.
beats.code:
M = mark_point(stage, p, (3, 2), color=RED, label="(3, 2)")
stage.equation(r"\left(\frac{1+5}{2}, \frac{1+3}{2}\right) = (3, 2)")

request: why do we have leap years?

beats.intent: Bars of how far the calendar drifts behind the Sun: 6, 12, 18 and 24 hours after 1 to 4 years
beats.narration: The Earth takes about three hundred and sixty five and a quarter days to go round the Sun, but a calendar year has three hundred and sixty five. Each year the calendar falls about six hours behind.
beats.code:
stage.title("Leap years")
b = draw_bars(stage, [6, 12, 18, 24], labels=["1 year", "2 years", "3 years", "4 years"], color=TEAL)
stage.caption("hours behind: a whole day after 4 years")

beats.intent: A number line of years 2020 to 2028 with the leap years 2020, 2024 and 2028 marked
beats.narration: The missing quarter days add up to a whole day every four years, so every fourth year gets a twenty ninth of February.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
nl = draw_number_line(stage, x_range=(2020, 2028))
for y in (2020, 2024, 2028):
    mark_point(stage, nl, y, color=YELLOW, label=str(y))
stage.caption("every 4th year: 366 days")

beats.intent: The number line beside 365.25 - 365.2422 = 0.0078 days a year too many
beats.narration: But a quarter is slightly too much. The fix: skip the leap day in century years, unless they divide by four hundred. So 1900 had none, and 2000 did.
beats.code:
stage.equation(r"365.25 - 365.2422 = 0.0078")
stage.caption("skip 3 leap days every 400 years")

request: 30 people like tea, 20 like coffee and 8 like both. How many like at least one?

beats.intent: Two overlapping circles labelled tea and coffee
beats.narration: Draw one circle for tea drinkers and one for coffee drinkers, overlapping where people like both.
beats.code:
stage.title("Tea, coffee or both")
tea = Circle(radius=1.8, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([-1.1, -0.3, 0])
coffee = Circle(radius=1.8, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([1.1, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Create(tea), Create(coffee))
stage.add(tea, coffee)
stage.label(tea, "tea 30", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(coffee, "coffee 20", direction=UP, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The regions filled in: 22 tea only, 8 both, 12 coffee only
beats.narration: Eight like both, so twenty two like only tea and twelve like only coffee.
beats.code:
for txt, x in (("22", -2.0), ("8", 0.0), ("12", 2.0)):
    t = Text(txt, font_size=40).move_to([x, -0.3, 0])
    stage.play(FadeIn(t), run_time=0.4)
    stage.add(t)

beats.narration: Adding thirty and twenty counts the eight in the middle twice, so take them off once: forty two people.
